items.text: Mohammadreza Zafarghandi, the Minister of Health, attributed the increase in drug prices to inflation in transportation and raw materials and called for insurance to cover these price hikes. He stated that there is no shortage of medicine and efforts are being made to import drugs through other means. He also mentioned the rising costs of aluminum and petrochemical products used in drug packaging.

Farideh Shojaei announced a sudden camp for the women's national football team to complete the visual archive of the Asian Cup matches. The camp aims to record parts that could not be filmed during the competition. The goal is to create a complete and lasting archive of the national team's participation in these matches.

The UK Maritime Trade Operations agency announced on Monday that it received a report about an incident in the Indian Ocean. The incident involved a tanker and military forces. No further details were provided.

Alireza Namvar Haghighi stated that the US pursues three simultaneous strategies: weakening the military power of the Islamic Republic, increasing economic pressure, and limiting Tehran's energy leverage. He added that part of the Islamic Republic's military capability in the Persian Gulf has been damaged, limiting Tehran's options. Continued tensions could lead to more costly scenarios.

Esmaeil Baqaei, spokesperson for Iran's Foreign Ministry, responded to the EU statement supporting the US economic war against Iran by saying Europe cannot claim strategic autonomy while acting as Washington's executor. He emphasized that autonomy requires the will and ability to make independent decisions. Baqaei urged Europe to choose between being an independent actor or merely echoing other countries' policies.
The US has carried out attacks. The IRGC's mine-laying project in Hormuz has failed. This topic was discussed in the program Cheshmandaz with Mahdi Mahdavi Azad.

Dmitry Peskov, Kremlin spokesperson, stated that discussing mediation in the Iran war remains difficult. This topic is scheduled to be discussed in the meeting between Vladimir Putin and Masoud Pezeshkian. They will also talk about Moscow-Tehran relations.

Alireza Babaei, CEO of Chadormalu Ardakan club, revealed that the Secretary-General of the Football Federation requested money from clubs under the pretext of helping the national team and rewarding female national team players who intended to seek asylum in Australia. Gol Gohar club paid 100 billion tomans for the national team's dispatch to the federation. The Secretary-General also asked clubs to pay amounts to encourage the female players to return.

Amir Ghalenoei, the head coach of Iran's national football team, attended the training of the national youth team and gave them advice. He called the youth the future of Iranian football. These remarks came while Ghalenoei has been criticized for relying less on young players in the past four years.

Reports indicate that police fired at young protesters in gatherings in Gachsaran and Ahvaz. The protesters demanded transparency in hiring and priority for local workers. Iranian officials have not yet commented on the incident.

Morad Vaisi said Trump has threatened to respond harshly to new attacks by the IRGC on US forces. The IRGC also stated that if targeted again, it will respond strongly. It appears the two sides are moving toward a new conflict, raising the question of whether it will escalate into a war or remain limited.

Donald Trump said that if the Islamic Republic cannot have nuclear weapons, there will be no subject left for negotiation. He considered military action against Iran necessary to prevent threats to the US and instability in the Middle East. Trump also stated that the Islamic Republic no longer holds the position of Middle East bully.

Morad Veysi, a senior analyst at Iran International, stated that 22 death sentences and dozens of heavy prison sentences have been issued for protesters in Isfahan. He described these actions as the Islamic Republic's revenge against the uprising of the people of Isfahan. He characterized this as part of a widespread wave of repression against the people of Iran.
The audio version of the Politics program with Murad Veisi has been released. The topic of the program is the expectation of a limited US attack. This program is presented by Iran International.

JD Vance said Donald Trump has sent a message to the Islamic Republic that Washington is aware of attacks on commercial ships and has the means to counter them. He accused the Islamic Republic of acting like a terrorist state. He warned that if the attacks continue, there will be consequences.

Morad Veysi, a senior analyst at Iran International, said that people this week focused mainly on three problems: gasoline shortage and possible price increase, severe food inflation, and confusion about school reopening and children's education status. These issues have caused widespread concern and reactions.

John Bolton called the oil blockade of Iran a major victory for the United States and said it would have a significant impact on Iran's economy. He also accused China of cooperating with Iran in money laundering financial assets. Bolton said that Trump is unlikely to increase pressure on China before Xi Jinping's visit to Washington.

A video shows a kilometer-long queue of cars at the Pak Gohar fuel station in Saravan. Citizens have been present since early morning to receive their gasoline quota. Due to the long queue, people have to wait for several hours.

The opening ceremony of the sixth World Nomad Games was held on Monday, 9 Shahrivar, in Bishkek. The event featured music groups, local dances, horseback riding, and fireworks. Several world leaders, including the presidents of Iran and Russia, attended the ceremony.

Mike Waltz, the US ambassador to the United Nations, said the Iranian regime does not care about its people and is only focused on maintaining control and money. He called for the enforcement of sanctions and action against shell banks and companies to cut off the regime's financial resources. Waltz emphasized that the world must play its part in this effort.

Donald Trump said the Islamic Republic will never acquire nuclear weapons. He warned that these weapons could lead to the destruction of Israel and the Middle East. Trump also said the Islamic Republic officials do not know who their leader is.

Benjamin Netanyahu said that overthrowing the Islamic Republic is one of Israel's goals. He added that the regime is now much weaker than before. Netanyahu emphasized that the defeat of the Islamic Republic is possible.

Ghassan Ashour said that regional countries bear the highest cost of the 'neither war nor peace' situation. This condition has harmed their economy, trade, energy exports, and tourism. Iran and the US use this opportunity to rebuild their strength, but the UAE, Qatar, and Iraq want to end this situation.

The Wall Street Journal reported that Dan Driscoll, the US Secretary of the Army, has submitted his resignation to Donald Trump. His resignation is still under review and has not been accepted by the White House. Tensions with Pete Hegseth, the Secretary of Defense, over the direction of the force and the dismissal of senior army officers have been cited as reasons for the resignation.

The Minister of Roads and Urban Development announced a serious disruption in the country's aviation radar systems. Due to the lack of radar, some flights are being guided mentally. A defense analyst warned that if navigation systems also fail, the risk of flights will significantly increase.

Six months after the start of US and Israeli attacks, Iranian officials have threatened to target oil exports from Persian Gulf countries if the naval blockade and US pressure continue. Mohsen Rezaei, Secretary of the Supreme National Security Council, said that if the blockade continues, Tehran will not allow 'a single drop of oil' to leave the Persian Gulf. Tehran is trying to spread the costs of the conflict among the US, regional countries, and the global economy by expanding the war.

US sanctions have led to the suspension of certain Treasury Department licenses, restricting educational services for Iranians. These restrictions affect international exams, admission processing, and tuition payments. Iranian students are facing new challenges in their education.

The UK Maritime Trade Operations center reported an incident 17 nautical miles east of Khasab in Oman. A tanker was hit by three unidentified projectiles while exiting the Strait of Hormuz. No casualties or environmental damage have been reported so far.

Mehdi Zare announced the occurrence of 9 earthquakes with a magnitude over three in east Tehran since the beginning of this year. He warned that active faults and soft sediments could increase the risk of earthquakes. The Mosha fault and Parchin and Ivanki faults threaten different areas of Tehran.

The UK Maritime Trade Operations announced that a tanker was targeted while passing through the Strait of Hormuz. The incident occurred 31 kilometers east of the Khasab area in Oman. The tanker was hit by three unknown projectiles.

Israel's public broadcaster Kan reported that the country is not satisfied with the Lebanese army's progress in disarming Hezbollah in southern Lebanon. According to a senior US official, Lebanese army officers have opposed the withdrawal of Israeli forces, fearing Hezbollah's return. The US official said they are working with both sides for a future agreement, but the process will take time.

Jack Keane said Iranian leaders believe they can outlast the US and hope Trump will be weaker after the midterm elections. Iran prioritizes preserving its leadership structure and disregards the suffering of its people. Keane predicted Iran will continue or escalate aggressive actions until the elections.

Scott Bessent, the US Treasury Secretary, is seeking international support to increase economic pressure on Iran at the G20 finance ministers' meeting. He announced that another bank will be sanctioned under the 'Economic Exclusion Campaign' this week, and said the US is ready to apply 'financial violence' if necessary. Bessent also reported full EU support and said that regarding sanctions on China for buying Iranian oil, 'all options are on the table.'

David Zini, head of Shin Bet, has secretly traveled to the United States. The purpose of the trip is to meet FBI officials and discuss sensitive issues including settler violence and the return of Netanyahu's son. This is Zini's first foreign trip since assuming his position.

Kayhan newspaper wrote that the government should listen to the concerns of families worried about the spread of unveiled behavior. The newspaper emphasized that preserving Iranian-Islamic culture and confronting unveiled behavior is the government's duty. Kayhan also mentioned some officials' opposition to warnings directed at unveiled individuals.

Amir Hamidi stated that Washington's current strategy is no longer just containment but aims to change the power calculations in Tehran. The US is pursuing three axes: nuclear, military, and economic. The goal is to severely limit the Islamic Republic's ability to threaten American forces and regional security.

Roghayeh Rezaei reported the confirmation and issuance of death sentences for detainees of the December protests. She described this as a sign of the regime's fear of renewed protests. She also emphasized that these sentences are part of an intensified crackdown and creating fear in society.

Six months after the start of the Iran war, its effects continue to impact the global economy. Reduced refinery capacity and restricted traffic in the Strait of Hormuz have increased fuel prices and energy import costs. This situation has increased inflationary pressures, interest rates, debt, and defense spending for governments.

Masoud Pezeshkian stated at the Shanghai Cooperation Organization summit that if the US returns to its commitments in the Islamabad agreement, the Islamic Republic will reciprocate immediately. He emphasized that sustainable security comes through mutual trust and respect for national sovereignty. Pezeshkian also said regional security depends on opposing force-based approaches.

Ali Dadpay stated that the dollar price has surpassed 210,000 tomans and the devaluation of the rial is no longer temporary. Iran's economy is moving towards a new equilibrium with high inflation and a weaker rial. He cited money printing, goods shortages, and sanctions as factors worsening the crisis and warned that people's purchasing power will decline.

Reza Goharzad stated that the Islamic Republic has long lacked a clear strategy and its only goal is to preserve the regime. He highlighted the role of the Revolutionary Guards in key decision-making. He also examined the impact of the US midterm elections and Trump's policies.

A citizen sent a video showing air pollution caused by the Qazvin power plant on Tuesday, 10 Shahrivar. The video was sent to Iran International. The issue of air pollution in this area has drawn attention.

A citizen in Shiraz reported that the electricity in their area is cut off for four hours a day. This was reported in a video to Iran International. The power outage has caused dissatisfaction in the area.

Masoud Pezeshkian said at the start of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization meeting in Kyrgyzstan that the Islamic Republic is ready to return to the Islamabad agreement with America. He accused America of not fulfilling its commitments and said if Washington returns to its commitments, Iran will

All 35,000 tickets for the match between Esteghlal and Persepolis at Naqsh-e Jahan Stadium in Isfahan sold out in less than 2 hours. The match will be held on Wednesday, 11 Shahrivar, and tickets are divided equally between fans of the two teams. Despite the stadium's 75,000 capacity, only half of the capacity was made available for ticket sales.

Morteza Kazemian commented on Masoud Pezeshkian's presence at the Shanghai summit. He questioned whether the positions of the head of the Islamic Republic government truly reflect the views of the hard core of power. Kazemian believes that the main power in Iran is held by the military and the IRGC, and Pezeshkian's statements do not accurately depict the political and economic reality.

Fatemeh Mohajerani, the government spokesperson, attributed the increase in the dollar price to 210,000 tomans to US sanctions. She said the government does not deny the economic pressure but is working to preserve employment and people's livelihoods. Mohajerani also criticized the repeated US violations of agreements.

On Monday, September 9, employees of the Pars Oil and Gas Company held protests at various sections and offshore platforms in the South Pars region. They demanded the removal of salary caps, full payment of wages, and correction of minimum wages. They also requested not to merge the oil pension fund with other pension funds and sought attention to their other demands.

David Zini, head of Israel's internal security agency, traveled secretly to Washington. He will discuss sensitive security cases with FBI officials, including threats against Benjamin Netanyahu's son. The trip took place on Saturday evening.

The disciplinary committee of the Football Federation rejected the complaints from Sepahan and Mes Shahrbabak clubs regarding Yaser Asani's presence in Esteghlal. The league organization has not registered any contract termination for Asani, and Esteghlal proved with a FIFA inquiry that Asani is a legal player. Asani's participation in upcoming Esteghlal matches has no legal obstacles.

Ahmad Taj, a resident of Tehran, was sentenced to seven years in prison by Branch 36 of the Tehran Province Court of Appeals. The sentence was announced on Monday, 9 Shahrivar. The lawyer stated that the verdict was issued without considering the defenses of the case's lawyers.

A video sent to Iran International on Tuesday, 10 Shahrivar, shows contaminated and unsafe tap water in Shiraz. The video depicts the water condition in the city. The issue of unsafe water in Shiraz has drawn attention.

The head of the Emergency Medical Services Center in Mazandaran reported that about 70% of the ambulances in the province are worn out. The emergency fleet consists of 180 ambulances operating in 107 bases. Many of these ambulances have been repaired multiple times and some may no longer be repairable.

Ismail Kowsari, a member of the Parliament's National Security and Foreign Policy Commission, said that some think the US will change following Pakistan's mediation, but it will not. Referring to the visit of Asim Munir to Tehran, he said that some imagine that the 'Great Satan' will become human, but they still have their satanic spirit, selfishness and arrogance.

Reports indicate severe economic hardship and poverty in Iran. Employees of Saipa company receive weekly wages, and parts suppliers are compensated with vehicles instead of money. Additionally, in Tehran, Basij forces set up checkpoints, harassing people and beating young individuals.

A citizen stated in a video that due to high prices and lack of money, they had to buy several food items on credit. This highlights the economic difficulties faced by people. The video was sent to Iran International.

Carlos Alcaraz returned to the US Open after four and a half months of absence due to a wrist injury and defeated Roman Safiullin in the first round. He won in three consecutive sets with identical scores of 6-4. Alcaraz will face Jaime Faria in the second round on Wednesday.
Hadi Rabuseh, an environmental activist from Mariwan, was arrested by intelligence officers on Friday, 6 Shahrivar. He was transferred to the detention center of this agency in Sanandaj.

Staff and medical personnel of Hakim Hospital in Nishapur held a protest today. They demanded payment of their dues and attention to their job-related issues. The protest took place around the hospital building.

Power outages across the country have disrupted people's lives and caused damage to businesses. As a result, hundreds of workers at the Aryan Steel Complex in Qazvin held a protest march. More details are provided in an interview with Leila Saadati.

Vahid Saravand, secretary of the CNG Association of Tehran, said the government must choose between cheap gasoline and cheap cars. Pointing to the price difference of cars in Iran and neighboring countries, he stated that the price of each liter of gasoline purchased under war conditions is 1 dollar and 20 cents.

Mohammad Reza Naqdi, senior advisor to the commander of the IRGC, urged residents of Israel to return to their countries and flee quickly. He said those who remain will be treated like Banu Qurayza. Naqdi emphasized that the treatment will be according to the Torah's judgment, not Islamic mercy.

Iran's national freestyle and Greco-Roman wrestling hopefuls teams traveled to Turkey early Tuesday, 10 Shahrivar, to obtain US visas and participate in the Las Vegas world championships. The competitions will be held from 20 to 26 Mehr in Las Vegas. The delegation is about 40 people and members are scheduled to appear at the US embassy in Ankara today.

Manouchehr Bakhtiari was sentenced to 10 years in prison by the Revolutionary Court of Bandar Abbas. His charges include propaganda against the regime, inciting people to conflict, and sending videos to foreign social networks. The sentence was verbally communicated to him in Bandar Abbas prison.

Hossein Aghaei says Iran's leverage in the Strait of Hormuz is weakening and Tehran is trying to maintain its cards by escalating tensions. The US is planning a response that likely will not lead to a full-scale war. There is a possibility of an operation against Iran in the southern front.

A protester in Tehran wrote on a wall addressing Ahmad Vahidi: "How many more thousands must be sacrificed due to your stubborn refusal to sign?" This protest refers to Ahmad Vahidi's role in shaping the hard stance of the Islamic Republic in war-ending negotiations. This issue was reported by the Associated Press.

A number of shareholders of Jihad Nasr Company gathered in front of Kermanshah Governorate. They protested financial violations in the company and demanded investigation. The protesters also reported delays in paying salaries and insurance premiums of the staff.
Citizens report a very poor employment situation and unemployment. Incomes have decreased while expenses have increased. Some workshops have closed due to economic problems, leading to unemployment.

Article 2 of the Countering Infiltration Plan requires registration and permits for scientific, research, educational, and cultural collaborations with foreign entities. This has drawn criticism from academics and researchers over restrictions on academic freedom and increased self-censorship. Experts warn that these limitations may reduce Iranian researchers' participation in international scientific networks and exacerbate specialist migration.

The Football Federation's Ethics Committee banned Payam Sadeghian for 15 years from sports activities and stadium attendance due to founding and managing a betting site. This ban lasts until 1413 in the Iranian calendar. Milad Hatami expressed surprise about Sadeghian's involvement in betting activities.

Ali Zarei Dozdarhesi, a political prisoner in Qezel Hesar prison, has been sentenced to death for corruption on earth. The sentence was issued by Branch 23 of the Tehran Revolutionary Court and notified on August 23, 2026. Charges include political activities, propaganda against the regime, and disturbing security.

A video of Hassan Hossein Khani dancing in shorts in a villa yard was released, provoking reactions from the community of eulogists. The House of Eulogists condemned the act, calling it a basis for enemies' exploitation. Hamshahri newspaper also described the video as disruptive to social norms.

The government spokesperson announced the removal of subsidized gasoline quotas for old vehicles. Long queues have formed at fuel stations in several provinces of Iran. The government plans to limit fuel supply with fuel cards and add a third gasoline quota priced at 10,000 tomans per liter.

The fifth week of the Iranian Premier League football starts with the match between Shams Azar and Tractor. Tractor has won all four initial games without conceding a goal and is leading the table. Shams Azar achieved their first victory last week after two losses and one draw.

Mohammad Mohebi joined Rijeka in the Croatian league after ending his contract with Rostov in Russia. He played 80 matches and scored 15 goals during three seasons at Rostov. Rijeka is the sixth professional club in the 27-year-old player's career.

Ali Zarei Dozdarhesi, a political prisoner and eye injury victim from the 1401 protests, was sentenced to death by Tehran's Revolutionary Court. He is held in Qezel Hesar prison in Karaj and previously lived in Germany. His case was reviewed by the Tehran Security Prosecutor's Office.

In Qeshm, the electricity of Mahtab commercial complex is cut off every night during peak customer hours. In Mohammadshahr, Karaj, the electricity of Chamran town was cut off from 4 to 9 pm on September 9, causing damage to people's electrical appliances. Economic difficulties have made medical expenses heavy for people and access to medical services difficult.

A video shows that on Tuesday, 10 Shahrivar, a citizen saw Mohsen Namjoo on the street and addressed him. The citizen said that Mohsen Namjoo has stepped on the blood of their children. This incident was recorded in a video sent to Iran International.

Mohammad Reza Aref warned Arab countries in the region at the Iran Cultural and Public Diplomacy Award ceremony that they will be overthrown if they do not change their path. He said the ruling system supports them only as long as they follow its desires. He also advised the southern sheikhs to return to their people and rely on them.

An Instagram survey by Iran International reports high unemployment and loss of job opportunities in Iran. This report coincides with the release of reports on the economic and employment crisis. More details are provided in an interview with Baharan Azadi.
The sentence of Vahid Ghadirzadeh, a political prisoner, has ended. He was previously granted a leave connected to release from Evin Prison. This news was reported by HRANA news agency.

Esmaeil Baghayi, spokesperson for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, criticized the US approach in negotiations as dictation. He emphasized that Iran's armed forces will not leave any aggression unanswered. These remarks were made in response to the US behavior in the talks.

On Tuesday, 9 Shahrivar, five Baha'i citizens residing in Karaj were arrested at the Shahr-e Rey Revolutionary Court to serve a one-year prison sentence. They were initially supposed to be transferred to Tehran Grand Prison but were held in Shahr-e Rey detention center, with a possible transfer to Qezel Hesar Prison. Their final place of detention is not yet known.

Masoud Pezeshkian thanked Russia's position on war and sanctions during his meeting with Vladimir Putin. He stated that it is possible to resist US unilateralism and that the US has no right to impose sanctions. Pezeshkian also said that the US attack had no logical justification.

Taraneh Rahimi, a 20-year-old horse riding coach from Isfahan, is shown in a video caring for a horse. She is one of two detained twin sisters sentenced to death. Her sister Romina has been sentenced to 25 years in prison.

On Tuesday, 10 Shahrivar, the April salary increase was deposited with a five-month delay and an insufficient amount. This amount is very low for elderly people who need hygiene supplies. Economic problems and high living costs, including overdue rent and medical expenses, have also been reported.

The Chabzi cafe and restaurant in Yazd was closed on Monday, 9 Shahrivar. This action was taken by judicial order due to hosting a music event with a DJ. Officers from the Public Places Supervision Department sealed the venue.

Jomaran website analyzed the support of part of Iranian society for Reza Pahlavi. This support was attributed to disappointment with the current situation and a nostalgic view of the past. Omid Mohaddes linked this condition to a society without a future seeking refuge in the past.

Navid Mohammadzadeh, an actor in cinema and theater, was removed from the orchestral theater "Arash" after posting in support of Palestine. This action caused widespread reactions. Sharareh Azizi explained the reasons behind the reactions and his removal.

Hamidreza Haji Babaei, the deputy speaker of the parliament, stated that an appropriate response must be given to the US and that the US should be surrounded in the region to prevent it from exporting oil. He emphasized that economic pressure is the US's main concern and officials have given a strong military response. He also mentioned that attacks should be combined.

Social media users have protested against the economic situation and inflation. They demand an end to the war and criticize threats to suppress protesters. This issue was reported by Adaleh Borang on Iran International.

Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf stated that the armed forces of the Islamic Republic have full control over the Strait of Hormuz. He said the US tries to pass some ships through the strait but faces resistance from the armed forces. He also mentioned military advancements in the Islamic Republic over the past 15 months.

The US Treasury Secretary likened the Iranian regime to a poisonous snake whose head has been cut off but its tail is still moving, unaware of its death. He said the regime's work is done and it will soon realize this.

Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, Speaker of the Islamic Consultative Assembly, said in a video message on Tuesday that a naval blockade is considered a military action under international law, and if they intensify the blockade, we will definitely respond militarily and everyone will lose. He said if the enemy's will is that we not export oil from the Persian Gulf, no one will be able to export oil. Ghalibaf added that America wants to pass through the southern route of the Strait of Hormuz contrary to the memorandum, and this will not be allowed.

Reports indicate a sharp increase in installment and credit purchases in Iran. This trend has expanded from durable goods to everyday items and food. This development follows heavy inflation and a livelihood crisis.
Mohammad Reza Aref, the first deputy of Pezeshkian, said that after the war, the situation improves week by week.

The Iranian University Professors' Union has warned that if the law to adjust faculty salaries is not fully implemented by the end of September 1405, academic activities will be suspended from October. This suspension will cover educational, research, executive, and advisory fields and will continue until the law is fully implemented. The union accused the Budget Organization of obstruction and warned about the consequences of neglecting faculty living conditions.

Two supertankers carrying Saudi oil were hit by unknown projectiles while passing through the Strait of Hormuz. The tankers were attacked near Oman, and their crews are safe. This incident coincided with a rise in global oil prices.

The price of the dollar in Iran's free market reached 213,700 tomans, marking the fourth consecutive record in four working days. The Central Bank governor stated that Iran does not have a currency shortage and is ready to inject up to two billion dollars into the market. These remarks came after the Supreme Leader's message emphasizing the need to portray Iran's strength.

Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf stated that if the US does not fulfill its commitments, the Islamic Republic will force it to do so by using power. He said the Strait of Hormuz will not be reopened until the US commitments are implemented. Ghalibaf also mentioned oil exports and essential goods imports during the implementation of the Islamabad agreement.

Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, Speaker of the Islamic Consultative Assembly, stated that if the blockade is intensified, a military response will be given. He considered this action a military act under international law. He also said that if the Islamic Republic cannot export oil from the Persian Gulf, no one else will be able to either.

Scott Bessent, the US Treasury Secretary, stated that Iran is trying to use the Strait of Hormuz as a choke point, but this situation will change within two years. He warned that any entity trading with the IRGC will face sanctions, and the economic pressure on Iran will continue. The US is also in talks with China to prevent Iran from acquiring nuclear weapons.

The university professors' union warned that if the full salaries of faculty members are not paid by the end of Shahrivar, their educational, research, and executive activities will be suspended from the beginning of Mehr. Jiran Moghadam emphasized that this union movement should go beyond just demanding professors' rights and that professors should see themselves as part of the university. He also stated that professors' rights cannot be separated from students' rights to education, security, and protest.

Mohammad Mahdi Khanmohammadi, a 19-year-old courier from Karaj, was killed on January 8, 2026, while helping the injured by a direct gunshot. A video shows his sister Sara Khanmohammadi lighting a candle in his memory and saying, "I neither forgive nor forget."

Scott Bessent, the US Treasury Secretary, stated on the sidelines of the G20 summit in North Carolina that all financial transfers and assets of the Revolutionary Guard are under the supervision of the United States.

One day before the 107th Tehran derby, a black market for tickets has emerged with prices up to 7 million tomans. These prices are much higher than the official ticket rates, and unofficial sales have increased. The match between Esteghlal and Persepolis will take place at 19:30 on Wednesday, 11 Shahrivar, at the Naqsh-e Jahan Stadium in Isfahan.

Trump and his advisors are considering resuming attacks on southern Iran to prevent the IRGC from attacking ships. A member of the National Security Commission called for a preemptive attack on the US. A senior Islamic Republic Army official stated that their forces are prepared for such an attack.

The Football Federation has organized a demonstration camp for the women's national football team. A documentary about some team members seeking asylum during the Asian Cup in Australia will be made at this camp. More details are provided in an interview with Raha Pourbakhsh.

The German Ministry of the Interior stated that the level of threat from the Islamic Republic against its opponents in Germany remains high. Berlin considers cross-border repression as part of the Islamic Republic's activities and does not tolerate such actions on German soil. This issue was discussed in an interview with an Iran International reporter.
Lionel Messi ended his final season in the Argentina national team after more than two decades. He is known for his lasting records and valuable trophies. This news was reported by Omid Aramesh.

The National Security Commission of the Parliament approved new articles of the strategic action plan for security and sustainable progress in the Strait of Hormuz. These include requirements for bank and insurance guarantees, tariff determination, and compensation payments to Iran by offending countries and companies. If compensation is not paid, passage permits through the Strait of Hormuz will not be issued.
Several explosions were heard in Bandar Abbas. No further details about the incident have been announced. Reports indicate that messages from the public about these explosions have been received.

A citizen stated that to receive a Saipa car promised in three months, they sold their spouse's gold and their own Pride car. However, it has been ten months and they have not yet received the car. This issue reflects customer dissatisfaction.

As the 1405-1406 school year approaches, many first-grade elementary students have not yet been registered. Reports indicate a significant number of middle school students have dropped out. This highlights a crisis of dropout and educational deprivation in elementary and middle school levels.
Multiple explosions have been reported in Konarak and Chabahar. The explosions were heard between 19:33 and 19:36. The number of explosions is reported to be between five and seven.
Bandar Abbas has been attacked again. No further details are provided in the text. This news was published by the source Vahid Online.

Shahram Khaledi referred to Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf's remarks, stating that the Islamic Republic tries to maintain its suppressive forces through demonization and dehumanization during crises. He noted that the current situation differs due to the severity of the economic crisis. He also mentioned that the government is worried about the gradual loss of suppressive forces.

On the early morning of Tuesday, 10 Shahrivar, the execution of a prisoner in Zahedan prison was carried out. The prisoner had been sentenced to death for theft and rape. The execution took place in Zahedan prison.

A 12-year-old child named Mohammad Tarek was killed during a wedding ceremony in Dashtiari due to celebratory gunfire. This incident occurred following the traditional shooting practice. The tradition and easy access to weapons have been frequently criticized.
Fars news agency reported hearing several explosions in Konarak and Chabahar on Tuesday night. People in these areas heard the explosion sounds. No further details have been provided.

CENTCOM announced that on Tuesday at 19:30 Tehran time, US forces launched attacks on IRGC targets in Iran. These attacks followed recent IRGC attempts to attack commercial ships and US forces in the region. CENTCOM described the action as a response to recent IRGC threats.

An environmental activist in Kermanshah was injured due to a landmine explosion during firefighting operations in the Bozin and Markhil protected area. The mine was left over from the Iran-Iraq war. The injury occurred in the leg.

In recent months, government interventions in areas such as closing cafes, blocking Instagram pages, and confronting tourism tours have increased. These actions are part of social control policies and limiting social autonomy in Iran. The main issue is the expansion of government interference in freedom of expression, privacy, and the right to participate in cultural life.

Homayoun Falakshahi stated that Iran's oil loading in August dropped to about 250,000 barrels per day. Iran's oil exports to China have effectively reached zero, and no tanker has been able to pass through the US naval blockade. Iran's oil revenue could reach zero by mid-December.

The US embassies in Israel, Jordan, and Qatar issued a security alert on Tuesday, 10 Shahrivar, stating that due to tensions in the Middle East, the security situation remains complex and there is a possibility of unforeseen escalation. The embassies asked American citizens to be vigilant and aware of possible flight cancellations, airspace closures, and travel disruptions. The alert said US diplomatic facilities have been targeted and that the Islamic Republic and its affiliated groups may target US interests and American citizens worldwide.

Keyvan Bana, a detainee from the December 2025 protests, was transferred to Torbat Heydariyeh prison to serve his sentence. He was sentenced to 10 years and one day of imprisonment. His charges include propaganda against the regime and espionage.

On Tuesday, Bandar Abbas, Qeshm, and Sirik were targeted by missile attacks. These attacks followed Donald Trump's promise of severe strikes on Iranian military targets. The United States carried out precise defensive strikes on positions in Bandar Abbas.

The virtual US embassy in Tehran warned its citizens not to travel to Iran for any reason and urged American citizens to leave Iran immediately. The warning is due to tensions and a complex security situation in the Middle East. There is also a possibility of flight cancellations and changes in border crossing procedures in Iran.

Scott Bessent, the US Treasury Secretary, announced that Washington has identified and will block the money and assets of the IRGC worldwide. He referred to the IRGC's accounts in the British Virgin Islands and $100 million homes of affiliates of the Islamic Republic. Bessent also said the US is 'burying the head of the poisonous snake of Iran' and stressed that a small group cannot remain in power forever.
IRIB news agency reported hearing an explosion sound in area 4 of Asaluyeh around 20:10 on Tuesday. The incident occurred at a specific time. No further details have been announced.

Donald Trump announced that the US military is conducting attacks on Iranian targets around the Strait of Hormuz. These attacks are in response to Iran's attempt to plant naval mines and missile launches at a US base in Jordan. Trump warned that if Iran retaliates, stronger attacks will follow.

The Tehran Revolutionary Court issued a death sentence for Ali Zarei, an eye injury victim of the 1401 protests. The Supreme Court also confirmed the death sentence for Ali Asghar Peygambari, a 26-year-old protester. These sentences are part of the ongoing wave of death sentences for protesters and political prisoners.
The US has launched a severe attack on southern Iran. Tehran has announced it will respond quickly. This news was reported by Niousha Saremi.

The Iranian Armed Forces Headquarters announced that in response to the US airstrike in Sistan-Baluchestan and Hormozgan, they will deliver crushing blows to the American enemy. Hossein Mohabi, spokesperson for the IRGC, stated that a severe punishment awaits the US. The US will regret its new attacks.
Two workers in the cities of Rafsanjan and Gachsaran died due to unsafe working conditions and lack of workplace safety while performing their jobs.

A citizen told Iran International that he and his wife, along with their two young children, have decided to migrate. His wife worked at a refinery and he was a nurse, but both were laid off. They are forced to migrate due to lack of financial and personal security.
A number of workers at Rajaei Port complained about wage arrears and job uncertainty. They demanded attention to their working conditions. This issue highlights the workers' labor problems.

Tractor football team drew 0-0 against Shams Azar in the fifth week of the Premier League in Qazvin. Tractor reached 13 points and temporarily remained at the top of the table. In other matches, Aluminium Arak defeated Gol Gohar, and Esteghlal Khuzestan drew with Chadormalu.

Donald Trump said that if Iran responds to US attacks, it could be completely destroyed. He warned that if Iran retaliates, there will be harsher attacks. Trump also made harsh remarks about the Iranian government and said that any agreement with them is worthless.

On the early morning of Tuesday, 3 Shahrivar, the execution of a prisoner in Sepidar Prison in Ahvaz was carried out. Also, a murder suspect in Tehran was sentenced to death. Two prisoners in Qazvin and Kerman were spared from execution after the victim's families expressed satisfaction.
IRIB reported that Jiroft civilian airport was targeted by a US attack. The news was released on the evening of Tuesday, 10 Shahrivar. Further information about the attack will be announced.

Donald Trump warned Tehran that if Iran retaliates against US attacks, they will face harsher targeting and may cease to exist if attacks continue. He described Tehran's actions as crazy and foolish and detailed recent attacks. Trump also expressed complete distrust in diplomacy with Iran.
The Islamic Republic of Iran Broadcasting news agency reported that Jiroft Airport in Kerman province was targeted on Tuesday night.

Abed Alizadeh, a citizen from Takab, was transferred to Miandoab prison after completing interrogation at the Intelligence Organization detention center in Urmia. This transfer took place on Monday, 9 Shahrivar.

The governor of Asaluyeh reported that around 20:10 on Tuesday night, an explosion was heard in the county. No details about casualties or financial damages have been released yet. This news was announced by the governor to Fars News Agency.

Media affiliated with the IRGC reported the start of Iranian missile and drone attacks on US positions. Fars and Tasnim news agencies announced the operation as a response to US attacks. US officials have not yet commented on these attacks.

At least 18 protests were held in various cities in Iran over the past two days. These protests involved hospital staff in Hakim Nishapur, green space contractors in Tehran, national housing applicants in Sanandaj, and other groups. Employees of the Pars Oil and Gas Company in the South Pars region also held protests.
Tasnim news agency reported that locations in Bandar Lengeh and Jask in Hormozgan province were targeted. This incident occurred on Tuesday night. No further details have been provided.

Mehdi Mahdavi Azad stated that the Intelligence Organization of the IRGC now issues permits for some Iranians abroad to return. These individuals are required to take a stance against opponents of the Islamic Republic or support the government in the war. In exchange, they are allowed to travel to and from Iran.
A video shows that on Tuesday, 10 Shahrivar, a missile fell in Khomain after launch. This incident was reported by Iran International.

Multiple severe explosions were reported around Qeshm and Bandar Abbas at 22:28 and 22:30. The sound of missile whistling was heard before the explosions. These explosions occurred in various areas including the Tolou Industrial Town of Qeshm.

Masoud Farhikhteh and Zartosht Ahmadi-Ragheb, two political prisoners in Karaj Central Prison, have been held in a separate room without basic facilities since July 30. They have been deprived of contact with their families, and family inquiries have so far been unsuccessful. The reason for these restrictions remains unclear.
The IRGC announced the start of operations in response to the US attacks on Tuesday night. The statement said that the US attacks would tighten the blockade of the Strait of Hormuz.

On the evening of Tuesday, 10 Shahrivar, a vessel caught fire in the waters of Qeshm near the village of Salakh. This incident was reported based on a video received by Iran International. Further details have not been announced.
Several missiles have been launched from Khomein. The number of missiles reported is at least three. The sound of the launches was also heard from Aligudarz.
A missile has just been launched from Yazd. This news has been confirmed by various sources. Further details have not been announced.
Three missiles were launched from Khomein. The third image was received from the sky of Azna in Lorestan. This event was reported on Tuesday, 10 Shahrivar.

The deputy security official of Khuzestan province announced that on Tuesday evening, a location near Ahvaz city was targeted by a missile attack from the US military. This news was reported by Fars News Agency. No further details about the attack have been provided.
Missiles have been launched from Kermanshah at different times. Explosions and missile launches have been reported in the area. Sounds of fighter jets have also been heard.
Videos received by Iran International show missile launches by the Islamic Republic from Khomein on the evening of Tuesday, 10 Shahrivar.
